title: A Polish faktura korygująca for pages billed twice, as a page and a KSeF FA(3) file
person: The bookkeeper of a small Poznań translation company correcting an invoice sent to a publisher in Gdańsk.
review: Faktura korygująca FK/2026/10/3 z 9.10.2026 do faktury FV/2026/09/041 z 30.09.2026 (numer KSeF 1234563218-20260930-000000-000000-00): -12 stron po 95,00 zł, netto -1 140,00 zł, VAT 23% -262,20 zł, razem -1 402,20 zł; NIP 123-456-32-18, NIP nabywcy 987-654-32-10. Plik FA(3) nie został wysłany do KSeF.
revised_review: 14 stron: netto -1 330,00 zł, VAT -305,90 zł, razem -1 635,90 zł; reszta bez zmian.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Dates on the page are in the d.MM.yyyy form.
The page is the locale's paper.
The page is written in the language of the order itself.
The page is laid out on the seller country's letter layout, or on the library's letter sheet (DIN 5008 Form B) where the library has none for it.
Every VAT number on the page carries its label.
Every number on the page traces to the order: what it says, and what the invoice arithmetic makes of it.
No field appears on the page unless the order carries its data.
The logical structure FA(3) accepts the file beside the page; skipped without it.

The NIP of both parties, both addresses, the net unit price, the rate and the tax on the page, with the corrected invoice and its KSeF number; the amounts are the correction itself, with a minus sign; the FA(3) is KOR.
Only the pages billed twice are corrected, at the invoice's own price; nothing is invented, and the reply says the file was not sent to KSeF.
The revision changes the number of pages and the totals that follow, and nothing else.
